'''Lucana''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She was a magician who received the oracle and called together two of her old friends to embark on a journey to save humanity.

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Lucana's first appearance is in Grand Quest - Those Who Lead.
